broker.name: XS.com
broker.tagline: On its own site since 2010. Its site names 7 regulators, including FSA (Seychelles), ASIC, and CySEC. Rules depend on where you live. Advertised leverage: Up to 1:2000.
broker.about: XS.com says it has operated since 2010. An address it publishes is Cyprus. Account names on its site include Cent, Micro, Standard, Pro, and Elite. Platforms named there include MetaTrader 4, MetaTrader 5, XS App, and Copy trading. The site names these regulators: FSA (Seychelles), ASIC, CySEC, LFSA, FSCA, FSC (Mauritius), and CMA. The company on an account depends on where the client lives. Minimum deposit is not a single number on the pages that loaded. The highest leverage figure taken from those pages is Up to 1:2000. Leverage increases losses as well as gains.
